tooltip.format_response: Format the response and merge it into the current workflow context.
tooltip.cache_ttl: Set to 0 to never expire. The value loads on the next workflow run.
tooltip.merge_maximum: Max inputs to wait for before output; extras are discarded.
tooltip.merge_timeout: Max wait time after the first input arrives.
tooltip.force_end: End the workflow immediately without waiting for other nodes to complete.
tooltip.ai_max_retries: Retry transient request failures only. 0 disables retries. The timeout applies to each attempt.
tooltip.ai_max_tokens: 0 uses the model default; some models count reasoning tokens in this limit.
tooltip.ai_temperature: Leave empty to use the model default. Higher values make output more random. Requires model support.
tooltip.ai_response_format: Structured JSON must pass validation against the schema below. Use an object schema without references.
tooltip.ai_native_schema: Advanced option: ask the provider to enforce the schema during generation. Requires model support. When off, the schema is supplied in the prompt. Both modes validate the result.
tooltip.ai_result_key: Access text, json, model, and usage under this variable, for example ai_result.json.result. Use a letter followed by letters, digits, or underscores.
